22:73.text: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create
a fly, even if they gathered together for it
. And if the fly should steal from them a
thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.

22:74.text: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal.
Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

22:75.text: Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

22:77.text: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.

22:78.text: And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty.
